name: tyagaraja-kritis
provenance: Compiled from commonly cited Tyagaraja kriti listings and standard Carnatic theory references, then machine-checked: every melakarta scale is derived from its mela number by katapayadi arithmetic and compared against the file, janya scales are checked against their parent mela's swara set, and every raga/tala/group reference must resolve. Raga and tala attributions vary between pathantarams and editions; each kriti carries a `confidence` field saying how much weight to put on its attribution. This is a working subset of the roughly 700 kritis attributed to Tyagaraja, not a complete catalog — see README.md for coverage and how to add entries.
